svg.title: Pi TimeLens Step summaries in a real narrow Pi terminal
svg.desc: A faithful transcript redraw from Pi 0.85.1 at 40 columns. Compact Step and Total summaries reflow into complete timing, token, cache, and subscription segments without repeating individual tool timing rows.
svg.metadata: Faithful redraw of tests/fixtures/real-pi-40.txt, selected from a real Pi 0.85.1 TUI session at 40 columns on 2026-09-08. Raw capture SHA-256: 897784db081847b127d167c0262b34be2c552b100aac86acb65da71d9fb6624b. Transcript text, wrapping, ordering, measured values, and theme roles are preserved; startup, transient working/status UI, update notice, footer, model identifier, filesystem path, and assistant reasoning are omitted.

g.text: Use the read tool to read auth.ts and
